10 dimensions of sovereignty failure. Each documented from official data. A country that cannot enforce its claims is not sovereign.
80% of APIs from China/India. Zero domestic manufacturing. PMPRB can't control prices. 6.5 million without a doctor.
Russia: 40+ icebreakers. Canada: 2 (one 50+ years old). Can't patrol NW Passage year-round. US doesn't recognise claim.
4th largest producer. 97% to one customer. Pipeline politics killed alternatives. WCS discount costs billions. Landlocked.
Government data on US cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP). CLOUD Act: US law reaches Canadian data. Five Eyes sharing without parliamentary oversight.
1.29% GDP (NATO: 2% ). 16,000+ shortfall. 3 CDS in 3 years. Procurement decades late.
Zero chip fabs. Critical minerals exported raw. Medical supplies imported. COVID exposed everything. Nothing fixed.
75% of exports to one country. US tariffs threaten auto, energy, agriculture. No comparable alternative market.
13+ layers of institutional capture. 10 oversight bodies, 0 enforcement. Crown immunity. Media captured. Pensions capture every citizen.
60%+ controlled by 3 companies. 14 -year bread price fix. 1 in 4 children food insecure. Northern communities 2-3x prices.
28+ long-term boil water advisories. $8.2B allocated. Some 10+ years. Canada voted for UN right to water — fails to deliver it domestically.
A sovereign nation can: make essential goods, patrol borders, sell to alternative markets, control its data, equip its military, and hold its government accountable.

Canada fails every test. Each failure is the product of policy choices made by captured institutions . Sovereignty requires capability. Capability requires institutions that serve the public interest. The institutions are captured. Sovereignty is fiction.
